verdicts.reason: Both are close: the maroon panel is shrunk into the middle of a wide banner, and the decorative X, slashes and circle lose their frame role and float over the busy hands. In A, 'MARKETING' nearly touches the panel's side edges and the panel almost touches the top and bottom of the canvas, so it feels cramped. A also spreads 'Join WADE team' apart more awkwardly. B gives the headline more padding inside the panel and keeps the four corner marks more evenly placed, though the banner is still just a shrunk copy of the original and the corner marks float over the busy photo.
